condition_implementation_notes.prompt_only: No external retrieval and no ontology-derived context.
condition_implementation_notes.prompt_rag: Attempts external Chroma vector retrieval; actual context exposure is audited per row.
condition_implementation_notes.ontology_prompt_rag: Attempts external RAG and adds a directly serialized PSQ-SCO semantic packet.
condition_implementation_notes.ontology_text_rag: Attempts external Chroma vector retrieval and adds ontology-derived text selected by a deterministic lexical ranker; actual external-context exposure is audited per row, and the ontology-derived records are not embedded by the current implementation.

source_similarity_policy: not calculated unless scenario-specific retrieval/query or claim-source evidence is exported
